summary_en: The paper introduces GGR-IR780, a small-molecule near-infrared photoacoustic probe whose signal decreases after cleavage by urokinase-type plasminogen activator. Phantom and cell-line experiments establish enzyme-responsive photoacoustic contrast and localized detection of a 2.5 mm target, supporting molecular photoacoustic screening applications.
